facts.fact: The finance ministry's account of the CENADI data centre study says the study was prompted in part by the absence of a consolidated national strategy on digital infrastructure and by excessive reliance on foreign data centres to host sensitive data; the document gives no event date, so its publication date is used, and it speaks of digital infrastructure strategy, not hosting policy by name.
